ocr_regions.text: An Institution of National Importance under Ministry of Education, Govt. of India)
The Student Activity Centre, NIT Jamshedpur; is looking to engage a Guest Coach on a purely temporary and
as-and-when-required basis to improve the performance of the Institute's teams in various intra- and inter-
institute tournaments for the academic year 2026-27.
level or State level or Inter
College competition in their respective discipline.
Desirable Qualification: Minimum one year of coaching experience in educational institute of repute_
General Information: A walk-in interview with respective practical field test will be held on 02.09.2026
at 10:00am in the office of Student Activity Centre, National Institute of Technology Jamshedpur
Application Requirements: Interested candidates must bring:
A written application addressed t0 the Dean (SW), Student Activity Centre, NIT Jamshedpur
Completed application form in the prescribed format
Self-attested photocopies of relevant educational qualifications
Original documents for verification during the interview
Engagement is purely on a temporary
No TAIDA will be provided for attending the interview or field test.
Applicants must submit a self-declaration regarding no pending criminal/FIR/court cases.
Coaches may be required to travel with the team for tournaments_
No campus accommodation will be provided.
The engagement as Guest Coach will be for the academic year 2026-27; however; the Sports Section
reserves the right to discontinue the engagement at any point of time:
